claim: Quality advantage over conventional persistent RAG, with context-only non-inferiority, for this fixed DML-trained agent on externally ingested scoped evolving-memory queries. Not adapter-independent memory causality or autonomous mutation superiority.

context_only.overflow: newest whole records that fit, preserving chronology; no query-aware selection

persistent_rag.storage: existing independent SQLiteBaseline WAL/FULL; immutable history plus separately qualified ordinary current-view metadata wrapper

dml.storage: supported DML with existing validation and authorization
dml.ranking: existing supported DML retrieval rules, separately qualified with shared semantic embeddings

budgets.token_counting: actual pinned tokenizer IDs; all rendered prompts, tool descriptions, evidence and feedback included

hardware.timing_requires: dedicated allocation or qualified absence of competing work; no service changes during this preparation

workloads.allocation: 6 families x 2 context pressure bands x 3 cache conditions x 6 arm orders x 20 distinct scenarios
workloads.fits_validation: complete rendered context-only request including metadata/system/task and reserved output fits without dropping records

cache_conditions: cold process, not asserted cold OS
warm model resident with independent arm caches and reset KV/RNG

acceptance_proposal.route: quality-primary conjunction only; no post-hoc efficiency alternative
acceptance_proposal.confidence: one-sided nominal 95% per required component; not simultaneous interval coverage
acceptance_proposal.subgroup_regression_scope: each family x context-pressure marginal against either baseline

statistics.binary_difference: stratified paired trinomial constrained profile likelihood; implementation, boundary rules and coverage calibration pending before execution freeze
statistics.cost_and_latency: 20000 fixed-seed paired cell-stratified scenario bootstrap resamples; boundary/tail calibration pending
statistics.power_status: normal planning only, not full-conjunction qualification
statistics.binary_estimand: Delta=sum(w_c*delta_c); heterogeneous cell-specific delta_c,q_c; constrain weighted mean null and profile nuisance parameters, no common-effect assumption

baseline_audit.smoke_quality_limitation: query contains target answer; retrieval functionality only, no agent quality evidence

pending_execution_bindings: neutral interface implementation, exact source CI and all-arm protocol competence
full prompts/tool schemas/source envelopes and neutral evidence verifier hashes
embedding runtime parity, validation and provenance attestation
complete exposure registry and independent held-out leakage audit/seal
generator/case/truth/order hashes and fixed seed schedule
cache ownership, block sizing, warmup and full-cost instrumentation qualification
statistical implementation, boundary coverage and full-conjunction power calibration
resource forecast and execution budget decision
independent execution approval and immutable complete run freeze
evidence_policy: Raw evidence on station. Publish compact outcomes/hashes only. Retain every attempt/failure; no selective retries, tuning on held-out outcomes or merge.

ingestion.driver: authenticated non-model drivers consuming identical explicit event fields; no answer-key access
ingestion.current_view: apply explicit same-source correction/version eligibility before ranking, top-k and compaction; retain immutable history separately
ingestion.independent_sources: preserve conflicting independent sources; never resolve ambiguity for one arm
ingestion.cost: all ingestion, checkpoint, maintenance and rebuild charged to receiving arm

final_contract.shared: required facts plus valid claims/citations supported by evidence actually presented to that arm
final_contract.context_evidence: inline source envelopes accepted without fabricated DML receipts
